In `spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb`, the only positive-path test for `execute` sets `poller.expects(:poll_feed).once`, which prevents the real `poll_feed` implementation (the RSS fetch/parse/import loop in `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`) from ever running under test. Similarly, `spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb` stubs `perform_retrieve`/`retrieved_recently?` and asserts call/no-call rather than exercising retrieval logic (RSS polling + HTTP fetch) in `lib/topic_retriever.rb`. `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb` is a controller spec without `render_views`, so it won’t render the new embed templates. This is a concrete coverage gap for newly added nontrivial logic, but it’s not itself a verifiable runtime defect from the diff.
